Summaries.eng: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

Legend has that it deep within the Magic Beast Mountain range, there exists a treasure that can temporarily boost one's fighting strength significantly. Many cultivators risked their lives by going deep into the mountain. All their efforts were in vain, as no one has ever returned. However, many remain obsessed with the elusive treasure, the Purple Spirit Crystal.

While Yun Zhi was removing the Lion King's seal, the relationship between her and Xiao Yan became closer due to the young man's attentive nursing. Perhaps it was because of the seal that the arrogance in Yun Zhi's voice when conversing with Xiao Yan began to gradually fade away. But due to Yun Zhi's negligence, their whereabouts were exposed.

Titles.eng: Special 2 (Song of the Desert): Episode 1 A Mirage

Summaries.eng: For thousands of years, the war between humans and the Snake people has never ceased. Although the Snake people are fierce, human could always rely on their strength in numbers. The Snake people were finally driven to live in a cruel and desolate place, the Tager Desert. Of course, the fight didn't end there. The conflict between two races just intensified more.

Titles.eng: Special 2 (Song of the Desert): Episode 2 Angry Sea, Wild Sand

Summaries.eng: Hai Bo Dong, the Ice Emperor accepted a job to find a Snake girl with amnesia in the Tager Desert. He didn't expect to find the person who hired him to be dead at the completion of his job. All the while, they were being pursued by the mysterious Snake warrior, and by the entire Snake clan.

Titles.eng: Special 2 (Song of the Desert): Episode 3 Song of the Desert

Summaries.eng: The Snake people are a race that adheres to ancient traditions. From one generation to the next, there will always be a Queen named Medusa. They are gifted with extraordinary abilities in order to lead the Snake people, and to resist the invasion of others. This ensured the continued survival of their race. This is why Queen Medusa's name is feared throughout the continent. Every generation of Queen Medusa is born into the world from an egg, where their immense strength continues to be inherited.

Breaking an engagement is something that is extremely embarrassing in the Douqi continent. But three years ago, Nalan Yanran enlisted the influence of the Yun Lan Sect and went to the Xiao family to break off the engagement. Making the Xiao family the biggest laughingstock in the Jia Ma kingdom. For the sake of regaining his dignity, Xiao Yan, in much anger, made a three-year pact with Nalan Yanran. During these three years of grueling training, Xiao Yan experienced various adversities and gradually grew throughout the process. He also gained a new appreciation for the Three-Year Agreement. Today, Xiao Yan sets foot in the Misty Cloud Sect as promised whereupon this time will mark the end of his grudge.

Summaries.zho: 曾经的修炼天才少年【萧炎】，不知从何开始他的修为一直停滞不前。在萧家被所有人认定是个修炼废物之后，与萧炎有婚约的【纳兰嫣然】上门退婚。萧炎不甘心萧家被羞辱，跟纳兰嫣然定下三年之约。虽然萧炎的父亲一直相信儿子会再次恢复其修炼天赋，但萧炎一时找不到解决问题的方向。这时他的纳戒中冒出个灵魂体，自称【药老】。萧炎之前不能凝聚的斗气之力都被他给吸噬去用来恢复自身了。【药老】让萧炎拜他为师，并承诺3年之内帮助萧炎提升实力，战胜纳兰嫣然。从此，萧炎踏上了修炼和炼药的旅途。

Summaries.eng:
Xiao Yan fallen from genius to cripple as his cultivation stagnating on 3-Star Dou Zhi Qi. Xiao Zhan is visited by patriarchs of two influential families in the Wu Tan City and they want to buy all markets in Wu Tan City and on that way forcing Xiao Clan out of the Wu Tan City. Xiao Zhan shows them marriage proposal between Xiao Yan and Nalan Yanran and they are surprised as that spoiled their plans. Nalan Yanran comes to the Xiao Clan to cancel the engagement as she doesn't want to marry an useless guy as Xiao Yan. She came with approval of the sect master of the Yun Lan Sect, Yun Yun as she is her direct disciple. Xiao Yan wanted to give her a divorce and Ge Ye immediately wanted to attack Xiao Yan as divorce is considered a great shame.
Nalan Yanran didn't want that and gives Xiao Yan 3-years deal where she will do everything he wants if Xiao Yan beats her and if she beats Xiao Yan, engagement will be canceled. Xiao Clan on that way got 3 years of piece.

Summaries.zho: 萧炎跟随药老在魔兽山脉修炼。结识了【小医仙】，对抗了作恶的佣兵团。还跟一位名为【云芝】的美女斗皇有过短暂的缘分，并意外获得了一种稀有的紫色【兽火】。萧炎通过炼药师工会的分会，获得了二品炼药师的资格。由于从药老那里学习的【焚决】是需要吞噬异火，他需要寻找关于异火的消息。跟随已知的讯息，萧炎他们来到了【塔戈尔沙漠】，偶遇已经被封印了实力的冰皇【海波东】。在寻找异火的过程中，萧炎还碰到了自己的大哥二哥，还有一位身怀特殊技能的女孩【青麟】。目前萧炎最有希望获得的异火，很可能在蛇人族女王美杜莎那边。

萧炎与药老来到蛇人族生活的地区，遇上了蛇人族女王美杜莎：一位斗皇巅峰实力的蛇人女子。正当萧炎被蛇人族追杀的时候，来了一批外来人，看似也是想从美杜莎手中夺取异火。美杜莎本想借异火之力突破斗皇，结果失败了。萧炎收服了美杜莎所变的一条小蛇，还捕获了异火【青莲地心火】。在逃亡过程中，萧炎发现那些外来人里，有一个人就是之前与他有过一段情缘的【云芝】。云芝没有为难萧炎，让他带走了异火。经过一番努力，萧炎终于炼化了他人生当中第一朵异火。收服异火之后，萧炎履行了承诺，回过去帮海波东炼出了破厄丹，让他再一次将实力恢复至斗皇等级。在追查失踪的【青麟】的时候，萧炎和海波东发现了作恶的墨承，萧炎大胆尝试融合自己的兽火和异火，制造出了威力巨大的【佛怒火莲】，并且炸死了墨承。

施展【佛怒火莲】的萧炎昏迷了过去，药老为了帮助萧炎抵挡火莲的波及，耗尽了自己的灵魂力，陷入了沉睡当中。萧炎想去寻找可以帮助恢复灵魂力量的草药或丹药，于是来到了加玛帝国的帝都。恢复到斗皇实力的海波东陪同萧炎，算是充当了一个临时保镖的角色。当来到米特尔家族地盘的时候，萧炎才知道海波东是米特尔家族背后的最大倚靠。在帝都，为了收集一些与灵魂力量有关的药草，萧炎化名为【岩枭】去给纳兰嫣然的爷爷驱毒疗伤，并参加了炼药师工会主办的炼药师大会比赛。在与出云帝国派来的炼药师对抗之后，萧炎夺取了炼药师大会的冠军。他将获得的草药炼丹后输入给药老所在的纳戒，希望能够唤醒药老。同时，他自己也将修为提升到了【大斗师】的境界，准备赴约与纳兰嫣然的三年之约。

萧炎逃离了加玛帝国，经过艰难险阻，来到了【迦南学院】与【萧熏儿】汇合。他来迦南学院的另一个目的，是想获取学院内隐藏的一朵异火【陨落心炎】。在【天焚炼气塔】中的修炼，让萧炎意识到他要找的陨落心炎救在塔的下面，而此时这个异火似乎并不安定且隐隐有暴走的迹象。同一时间，学院附近的【黑角域】，有众多势力也在窥视着迦南学院。其中一个就是药皇【韩枫】，此人是药老昔日的养子和学生。可惜，为了获得焚决，他勾结了魂殿，背刺了药老，让药老不得不以灵魂形态存活在纳戒中。就在陨落心炎爆发的时刻，韩枫带着一种黑角域的狠角色来抢异火，结果被学院长老们和萧炎阻击并击退。萧炎不幸被陨落心炎吞噬。。。
